mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_platform_metrics ( metric_date, total_users, new_users, total_courses, new_courses, total_orders, gmv_cents, refund_cents ) VALUES ( #{metricDate}, #{newUsers}, #{newUsers}, #{newCourses}, #{newCourses}, #{orders}, #{gmvCents}, #{refundCents} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_users = total_users + VALUES(new_users), new_users = new_users + VALUES(new_users), total_courses = total_courses + VALUES(new_courses), new_courses = new_courses + VALUES(new_courses), total_orders = total_orders + VALUES(total_orders), gmv_cents = gmv_cents + VALUES(gmv_cents), refund_cents = refund_cents + VALUES(refund_cents), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
